All services

Select an offering to see what it involves.

Find the right opportunities

  • Assess opportunities

    Explore where your strengths meet demand, test the commercial potential and decide which opportunities deserve attention—and which to leave aside.

    4 offerings

    • Opportunity assessment

      Find where your strengths could meet demand.

      What we do
      Explore sectors, customer needs and applications in the other market, and assess their fit with your capabilities.
      What you receive
      An assessed long list of opportunities, with reasons for including each.
      Why this matters
      A grounded starting point for deciding where to investigate further.

      A prioritized short list or an entry case is not included automatically; each is a separate offering you can select.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Developing a platform evolution roadmap

      Discuss this offering

    • Customer and counterpart screening
      What we do
      Identify and screen potential customers, partners and competitors.
      What you receive
      A screened list with contact routes.
      Why this matters
      Understand whom you would actually be dealing with.

      Discuss this offering

    • Commercial qualification
      What we do
      Test shortlisted opportunities for buyer value, economics, entry requirements and risk.
      What you receive
      A qualification summary.
      Why this matters
      Identify weaknesses before committing more resources.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Creating a new business possibility from existing assets

      Discuss this offering

    • Prioritized pursuit agenda
      What we do
      Rank qualified opportunities and identify first steps, resources and decision points.
      What you receive
      A proposed agenda for management approval.
      Why this matters
      Decide where to act, and when to continue or stop.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      Discuss this offering

Turn interest into commitments

  • Develop workable agreements

    Help the parties agree on commercial responsibilities, expectations and terms—including how a pilot or trial would lead to a further decision.

    4 offerings

    • Collaboration design
      What we do
      Develop options for contributions, rights, decisions and commercial arrangements.
      What you receive
      A proposed collaboration structure.
      Why this matters
      Give the parties a shared basis for negotiation.

      Discuss this offering

    • Pilot-to-decision planning

      Give the trial a clear purpose—and a decision to inform.

      What we do
      Help the parties establish what the pilot must demonstrate, how it will be funded, when it will be reviewed and what commitment could follow.
      What you receive
      A proposed pilot framework covering acceptance criteria, responsibilities, funding, timing and next steps.
      Why this matters
      A trial designed to support a decision, rather than continuing without a clear conclusion.

      The parties retain their own approval and purchasing decisions.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese business seeking engineering capability in India

      Discuss this offering

    • Negotiation support
      What we do
      Prepare positions and support discussions between the parties.
      What you receive
      Documented options and agreed terms if negotiations conclude.
      Why this matters
      Address misunderstandings before signing.
